required_inputs.title: Required Sensors
required_inputs.description: Map your power sensors to EMS inputs.

inverter.title: Inverter Control (optional)
inverter.description: Map your inverter's normal operating mode. Skip if you have no home battery. When the EV is charging, EMS writes this mode with a discharge-power cap to prevent the battery from draining into the car.

data.inverter_verb_self_use: SELF_USE option string (your inverter's normal/self-use mode)
data.inverter_power_target: Inverter power target entity (W) — for setting discharge cap

ev_charger.title: EV Charger
ev_charger.description: Configure EV sensors. EMS publishes sensor.ems_ev_charge_target_power (W) — wire your own automation to act on it.

price_sources.title: Price Sources
price_sources.description: Required for Deadline and Price-optimised charging modes. Skip if you only use Solar-only or Off.
